rules.reason: Irreversible or broad data destruction is prohibited.
patterns: \b(drop\s+(database|schema|table)|truncate\s+table|format\s+(disk|volume)|wipe\s+(all|the)\s+(data|backups?))\b
\b(delete|erase|destroy|remove)\s+(all|every|the entire)\s+(production\s+)?(data|backups?)\b
(永久|不可恢复|不可逆).{0,18}(删除|清除|销毁)
(删除|清除|销毁).{0,18}(全部数据|所有备份|生产数据)
alternatives: Create a scoped backup and recovery plan.
Move selected records to a reversible quarantine or archive.
Produce a dry-run deletion manifest for human execution.

rules.reason: Credential, identity, or privileged-access mutation is prohibited.
patterns: \b(reset|change|rotate|revoke|issue|create)\s+(the\s+)?(password|credential|secret|token|api key|ssh key)\b
\b(grant|assign|enable|add)\s+[^\n]{0,30}\b(admin|administrator|root|sudo|owner)\b
(重置|修改|轮换|吊销|签发|创建).{0,15}(密码|凭据|密钥|令牌|token)
(授予|添加|提升|开启).{0,15}(管理员|root|sudo|所有者|最高权限)
alternatives: Prepare a credential-rotation checklist without accessing secret values.
Draft a least-privilege access request for a human administrator.
Audit current permission metadata in read-only mode.

rules.reason: Disabling or weakening security, authorization, backup, or audit controls is prohibited.
patterns: \b(disable|bypass|remove|weaken|turn off)\s+[^\n]{0,35}\b(audit|logging|authentication|authorization|mfa|2fa|firewall|security|backup)\b
(关闭|禁用|绕过|移除|削弱).{0,18}(审计|日志|认证|鉴权|授权|多因素|防火墙|安全控制|备份)
alternatives: Diagnose the control failure using read-only evidence.
Propose a narrowly scoped L0-L2 configuration change that preserves audit and recovery.
Escalate the required control change to a human administrator.

rules.reason: High-impact production operations and irreversible migrations are prohibited.
patterns: \b(force\s+deploy|force\s+push|destroy\s+(the\s+)?(production|prod)|terminate\s+(the\s+)?(production|prod)\s+(cluster|service)|irreversible\s+migration)\b
\b(change|replace|delete|remove)\s+[^\n]{0,25}\b(production|prod)\s+(database|dns|firewall|cluster|network)\b
(强制部署|强制推送|销毁生产|不可逆迁移)
(修改|替换|删除|移除).{0,15}(生产数据库|生产DNS|生产防火墙|生产集群|生产网络)
alternatives: Prepare and verify a staging change with rollback steps.
Generate a production runbook for explicit human execution.
Perform read-only health checks and impact analysis.

rules.reason: Making external commitments or representations on behalf of a human is prohibited.
patterns: \b(send|publish|announce|promise|commit|approve|accept|sign)\s+[^\n]{0,40}\b(on behalf of|to (the )?(customer|client|public|press|regulator))\b
(代表|代替).{0,12}(Zac|Vivi|人类|公司).{0,18}(发送|发布|承诺|批准|接受|签署)
(向客户|向公众|向媒体|向监管机构).{0,18}(发送|发布|宣布|承诺)
alternatives: Draft the message or commitment for human review without sending it.
Prepare an internal decision brief with unresolved points clearly marked.
Ask the responsible human to perform the external action.

rules.reason: Financial transactions and binding legal actions are prohibited.
patterns: \b(pay|transfer|wire|refund|purchase|trade|sign|accept)\s+[^\n]{0,35}\b(money|funds|invoice|contract|agreement|legal terms|securities)\b
(支付|转账|汇款|退款|购买|交易|签署|接受).{0,18}(资金|款项|发票|合同|协议|法律条款|证券)
alternatives: Prepare a non-binding comparison or approval packet.
Draft transaction or contract details for authorized human review.
Perform read-only reconciliation without initiating a transaction.

rules.reason: Exporting or disclosing secrets, credentials, or sensitive personal data is prohibited.
patterns: \b(send|upload|export|publish|post|copy)\s+[^\n]{0,40}\b(passwords?|credentials?|secrets?|tokens?|private keys?|customer pii|personal data)\b
(发送|上传|导出|发布|复制).{0,18}(密码|凭据|秘密|密钥|令牌|客户隐私|个人敏感信息)
alternatives: Provide a redacted schema or aggregate report.
Keep sensitive values in place and return only verification metadata.
Ask a human data owner to approve a separately governed transfer.

rules.reason: Deleting audit evidence or weakening the L3 boundary is prohibited.
patterns: \b(delete|erase|rewrite|falsify|fabricate|tamper with)\s+[^\n]{0,35}\b(audit|governance|history|evidence|decision record|task card)\b
\b(modify|remove|disable|bypass|override|weaken)\s+[^\n]{0,35}\b(l3|hard prohibition|service policy|authority boundary)\b
(删除|清除|伪造|篡改|改写).{0,18}(审计|治理记录|历史记录|证据|决策记录|Task Card)
(修改|移除|关闭|绕过|覆盖|削弱).{0,18}(L3|硬禁止|服务策略|权限边界)
alternatives: Append a corrective audit entry while preserving the original record.
Propose a policy amendment for human governance outside Hermes execution.
Add a narrower L0-L2 exception without changing the hard boundary.

rules.reason: Unbounded automation, unknown-agent fan-out, and uncontrolled scope expansion are prohibited.
patterns: \b(send|dispatch|assign|spawn|delegate)\s+[^\n]{0,35}\b(all agents|every agent|unknown agents?|unregistered agents?|unlimited agents?)\b
\b(run|repeat|retry|loop)\s+(forever|without limit|indefinitely|unbounded)\b
(派发|分配|生成|委派).{0,18}(所有Agent|全部Agent|未知Agent|未注册Agent|无限Agent)
(无限|无上限|永久).{0,12}(运行|重试|循环|扩散)
alternatives: Limit dispatch to the registered Zac and Vivi Agents.
Set an explicit task count, deadline, retry cap, and owner.
Run one bounded pilot and review its audit trail.
